summary: All 20 frozen cells, request metrics, online actions, archives, costs, and current bounded claims reconcile. This is a provisional integrity PASS, not method GO or semantic-quality validation.

recomputation.byte_difference_reason: unordered Python set serialization in held bookkeeping only

A_ground_truth_provenance.evaluation_input: pinned WikiText-103 train Arrow shard with retained hashes and disjoint document identities
A_ground_truth_provenance.details: No model-generated reference is used as ground truth. Semantic quality is unmeasured and the report states that boundary.

B_metrics_denominators.details: All request/token alignment, elapsed time, throughput, completion, TTFT, mean TPOT, ITL, work and host-time partitions recompute. Costs are not double counted; A/A is not subtracted or used as a noise bound; requests/tokens are not treated as independent repeats.

C_evidence_existence.details: Manifest, run order, 20 read-back archives, raw files, terminal statuses, source/runtime fingerprints and required per-cell artifacts exist and reconcile. The qualification NOT_YET_RUN field is a pre-measurement snapshot, not terminal status.

D_dead_code_future_leakage.details: The executed path invokes real native preemption/recompute and advances independent policy state. Decisions use only current scheduler/KV state and declared max length; no future trace or offline masking is presented as rerun.

E_fair_baseline_scope.details: Within-block resources and inputs match, safe29 changes admission only, native_aa remains separate, unfavorable signs and output differences are retained, and the report avoids significance, noninferiority, continuous-isolation, semantic-quality and method-GO extrapolation.

F_evaluation_type.details: The semantic axis has no ground truth or human evaluation. Performance is directly measured in native vLLM rather than simulated; quality remains unmeasured.

claim_impacts.claim: rotate improves throughput, mean completion and maximum ITL versus headroom in all four observed blocks
rotate shortens native maximum ITL while increasing mean completion in all four observed blocks
significance, noninferiority, population generalization, MoE specificity, novelty or method GO
